title: "E103: ASCII arrow inside a bare label"

<!-- Generated by `delta gen-docs`. Do not edit. -->

In `-label->` the first `->` ends the edge, so a label containing `->` needs brackets: `-[a, X -> YZ]->`. The quick fix adds them.

## Example

```delta error
pda P {
  start q0
  q0 -a, X -> YZ-> q1
}
```
